author: Sideprojects
description: The future of warfare was supposed to look like science fiction. From caseless ammunition rifles to actual rocket pistols to superguns capable of reaching hundreds of kilometres, military engineers poured fortunes into revolutionary weapons programs. This video explores six spectacular failures that promised to transform combat but ultimately failed completely.
title: 'Next Generation' Weapons That Failed Completely.
